render_prompts.full_prompt:
Medium shot tracking the skateboarder as they glide across the concrete. At 2 seconds, the skater removes their back foot from the board and drags the sole of their shoe on the ground. A small cloud of dust appears where the shoe scrapes the concrete. At 4 seconds, a yellow animated arrow labeled 'Friction' appears next to the dragging foot, pointing backward against the direction of motion. The skater's speed visibly decreases. The camera's tracking movement slows down to match the skater's deceleration. The skater comes to a complete stop at the 15-second mark. The camera is now static. At 17 seconds, the scene cuts to a solid dark blue background. White text fades in, listing three numbered points:
1. An object at rest stays at rest, and an object in motion stays in motion.
2. Force equals mass times acceleration (F=ma).
3. For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.
This text remains on screen until the end of the shot.
